name: MasterChef India
description: Indian version of the competitive cooking reality series.

Second Elimination / Pressure Test and Immunity Pin Challenge
Second Mystery Box and Tag-Team Challenge
Third Mystery Box Challenge and Pair Challenge
Fourth Mystery Box Challenge and Pair Challenge
Team Cheese Quiz and Second Invention Test
Third Team Challenge and Sixth Elimination / Pressure Test
Fourth Team Challenge and Fifth Mystery Box Challenge
Ranveer Singh and Vaani Kapoor Challenge
Ticket to Finale and Sixth Mystery Box Challenge
The Semifinals: Part 1 & Part 2 and Seventh Mystery Box Challenge
Mystery Box and the Immunity Pin
India Ka Swaad
videos.overview: Home cooks from across the country present their best dishes to the judges. Who will win the apron?

videos.title: Home Cooks Ka Passion
videos.overview: Home cooks from across the country continue to impress the chefs with their dishes. Who will take home the aprons today?

videos.title: Dil Ki Awaaz
videos.overview: Home cooks from Delhi, Lucknow, Mumbai and other cities appear in front of the chefs with their signature dishes. Will they bag the apron?

videos.title: Passion Se Pehchaan
videos.overview: MasterChef finds its top 36 home cooks who will be cooking in the MasterChef kitchen for the first time. Will they manage to impress the chefs?

videos.title: Hindustan Ke Haatho Ka Jaadu
videos.overview: Top 36 contestants present their best dishes to impress the chefs.

videos.title: First Challenge For Top 16
videos.overview: The top 16 home cooks put their culinary skills to use and present their best in the first challenge given by the chefs.

videos.title: Taste, Innovation And Presentation
videos.overview: After Chef Garima displays a flicker of her culinary skills, the home cooks are given a task to use alternative ingredients to make a Pan Asian dish. Will they manage to impress the chefs?

videos.title: A Cook's Kingdom
videos.overview: The cooks are faced with the challenge of arranging their own cooking stations followed by a task which involves the cooks making a four-course meal.

videos.title: The Iconic Mystery Box Challenge
videos.overview: The home cooks get thrown a curveball as the mystery box presents them with ingredients that they have never worked with before. Can the home cooks show their versatility and prove why they deserve a spot on the show?

videos.title: On Par With The Best
videos.overview: The bottom six home cooks face a pressure test, where they replicate complex dishes made by our celebrity chefs, Vikas Khanna and Ranveer Brar. Can they showcase their technical abilities and avoid elimination?

videos.title: Naya Hafta Naye Challenges
videos.overview: Taking the taste, innovation and presentation a notch higher this week, the home cooks take over their cooking stations for their next challenge that will win them an 'immunity pin'.

videos.title: MasterChef Ka Brahmastra
videos.overview: The task of winning the 'immunity pin' continues with the remaining eight home cooks. What new tasks have the chefs planned for the home cooks?

videos.title: First Team Service Challenge
videos.overview: The task of winning the 'immunity pin' continues with the remaining eight home cooks. What new tasks have the chefs planned for the home cooks?

videos.title: Essence Of Being A Chef
videos.overview: Home cooks are under extreme pressure as they tackle with time while keeping food quality in check. Will they manage to impress the chefs and the customers?

videos.title: Bouncing Back From Pressure
videos.overview: The home cooks gear up for a task that will decide their fate in the game ahead. Who will get eliminated from the MasterChef kitchen?

videos.title: Home Cooks Pohche Goa
videos.overview: The home cooks are in Goa as they gear up for a new challenge, which involves the cooks diving into the history of Goa and coming up with a dish to impress the chefs.

videos.title: Team Challenge in Thalassa
videos.overview: The home cooks gear up for their first team challenge in the famous greek restaurant 'Thalassa' in Goa, wherein they have to make a three-course Mediterranean meal. Which team will succeed in the challenge?

videos.title: Preparing Meals Under High Pressure
videos.overview: The home cooks continue to prepare their meals to impress the chefs in 'Thalassa' under a time crunch. Will they deliver the taste the chefs are looking for?

videos.title: Republic Day Challenge
videos.overview: The chefs put forth a 'Double Tag Team Challenge' in front of the home cooks wherein only one person from a team can cook at a time. How will the home cooks fare in this challenge?

videos.title: Black Apron Challenge
videos.overview: The four home cooks at the bottom will compete in the 'Black Apron Challenge' wherein they have to make a progressive Goan dish. Who will come out on top and impress the chefs?

videos.title: Bachpan Ki Yaadein
videos.overview: After spending a week in Goa, home cooks are back in the MasterChef kitchen and are given a task to make a dessert that will take them back to their childhood. How will the home cooks fare in this challenge?

videos.title: Precision And Perfection
videos.overview: The home cooks are tasked with making a traditional Japanese 'Bento' in their own style. Will the home cooks manage to impress the chefs?

videos.title: Muhavaron Se Cooking
videos.overview: The home cooks are tasked to prepare a dish with an ingredient coming from a proverb that their partner chooses for them. Will they manage to display their versatility?

videos.title: French Meringue Challenge
videos.overview: The home cooks are tasked to prepare a not-so-simple French Meringue with stiff peaks, perfect texture, and stability. Will home cooks succeed in this task?

videos.title: Ande Ka Funda
videos.overview: Home cooks make different dishes with the star ingredient of the day, egg. Will the chefs approve of these dishes?

videos.title: Importance Of Culinary Knowledge
videos.overview: The Home Cooks are tested on their culinary knowledge along with technical cooking skills in this episode of MasterChef India.

videos.title: The Food Truck Challenge
videos.overview: The home cooks get divided into three teams and are asked to run a food truck. Will they be able to work together and pull off this challenge?

videos.title: Chalti Ka Naam Gaadi
videos.overview: The guests at the food truck challenge are in for a treat as they savour the delicious dishes created by talented home cooks. This exciting competition puts the participants' culinary skills to the test, as they not only have to cook up a storm but also handle all aspects of running a food truck business. From menu planning to food preparation, presentation and service, the contestants must showcase their culinary prowess and business acumen.

videos.title: Cooking By Ear
videos.overview: The home cooks are put into pairs and asked to create identical dishes without the benefit of sight. With only audio to guide them, they must rely on their cooking instincts and communication skills to bring their culinary vision to life.

videos.title: Unexpected Swap
videos.overview: The chefs put the home cooks to the test with a challenging twist in the elimination round. Can they rise to the occasion and prove their culinary prowess?

videos.title: Blind Relay Challenge
videos.overview: The home cooks showcase their knife skills before being divided into three teams for the blind relay challenge. The teams compete in a high-stakes race for the coveted immunity pin.

videos.title: Closer To The Immunity Pin
videos.overview: The home cooks must impress the chefs with their charcuterie board then they must elevate their skills and create the perfect egg ravioli. Can they handle the pressure and come out on top?

videos.title: Face Off Against A Professional
videos.overview: Priyanka faces the last hurdle between her and the immunity pin as she faces off against Manav, a professional chef from Bangkok who works in Chef Garima's restaurant. Will she clutch up and win the challenge?

videos.title: Immunity Pin Jeetne Ka Dusra Mauka
videos.overview: The home cooks are given a fridge with ingredients out of which they will have to make their dish in order to win the 'Immunity Pin'. How will the cooks fare in this challenge?

videos.title: Destiny On The Menu
videos.overview: As the home cooks gather in the kitchen, they decide to leave everything to destiny and let fate choose their ingredients. Will their luck take them closer to the Immunity pin?

videos.title: Going Organic
videos.overview: Home cooks visit an organic farm and split into two teams to prepare a delicious brunch spread. With fresh, organic ingredients at their disposal, they chop, cook, and plate to impress the chefs. Who will come out on top in this farm-to-table cooking challenge?

videos.title: 75 Years Of Taste Of India
videos.overview: MasterChef India takes a deep dive into the heart of Indian cuisine as home cooks are tasked with showcasing the best of the country's vibrant flavours and tastes. With celebrity chef Kunal Kapur leading the way, who will rise to the top of this flavourful challenge?

videos.title: A Sweet Surprise
videos.overview: The home cooks get a sweet surprise visit from their family members, bringing along a special ingredient. Can they elevate their dishes using this core element and impress the chefs?

videos.title: Cooking With Love
videos.overview: Home cooks and their families team up to create incredible dishes filled with love and creativity. With their core ingredient, they impress the judges with delicious flavours and unique presentations. Witness the power of cooking with family love

videos.title: Agni Pariksha Challenge
videos.overview: The home cooks prepare for a blazing challenge using fiery ingredients and tools from their personal mystery boxes to create a culinary masterpiece.

videos.title: Swaad Aur Sehat Ka Balance
videos.overview: The chefs challenge the home cooks to create a dish that incorporates both health and flavour. Usage of fresh ingredients, spices, and cooking techniques to craft a dish that's delicious and nourishing. Will the home cooks ace this challenge?

videos.title: Desi Twist Challenge
videos.overview: The home cooks are tasked with preparing an international dish using the vibrant and aromatic flavours of Indian spices. They get to work, blending traditional Indian spices with international techniques to create a unique and delicious fusion dish.

videos.title: Holi Special
videos.overview: Excitement is in the air as MasterChef India's Holi special episode unites home cooks and Super Chefs for a thrilling culinary journey. Together, they aim to craft colourful and festive dishes that truly capture the essence of the festival.

videos.title: Flavours of Festivity
videos.overview: Prepare for an electrifying episode of MasterChef India, where the home cooks are fiercely competing for the coveted 'Ticket To The Finale'. With the assistance of Super Chefs as their sous chefs, the competition has never been more intense.

videos.title: Ode To The Millets Of India
videos.overview: The home cooks brace themselves for their ultimate challenge yet, as they race towards winning the coveted 'Ticket To The Finale'. Chef Garima springs a surprise by tasking them to replicate her complex dish, pushing their technical abilities to the limit.

videos.title: A Treat Of Arab Street
videos.overview: The home cooks arrive at the famed water park of Abu Dhabi to face a new challenge, where they will have to pair up and work together in teams of two to create mouthwatering street food.

videos.title: Waqt Ka Khel
videos.overview: When presented with the mystery boxes in Abu Dhabi, the home cooks face a distinctive and unprecedented challenge as they must decide how to utilize the revealed ingredient within the given time frame.

videos.title: A Culinary Experience At The Ferrari World
videos.overview: The home cooks embark on a culinary adventure to Abu Dhabi's Ferrari World, where they're divided into two teams and given the exciting challenge of portraying their life experiences through the creation of three unique pizzas. This task allows them to unleash their creativity and infuse each dish with their own personal flair and flavours.

videos.title: Pizza Showdown
videos.overview: As both teams present their next two pizzas to the guests and chefs, the question remains - which team's culinary efforts will be rewarded with the most coins from the guests?

videos.title: Skill Of The Grill
videos.overview: Home cooks have a thrilling opportunity to showcase their culinary prowess and ingenuity by taking on the challenge of creating a delectable dish using only the grill as their cooking medium. With no other tools at their disposal, this challenge calls for resourcefulness and innovation.

videos.title: Liquid To Solid Challenge
videos.overview: Upon returning from Abu Dhabi, the home cooks are greeted with a welcome drink and challenged to translate its flavours into a solid form dish. Can they transform the taste of the drink into a delectable dish?

videos.title: India Ki Rooh
videos.overview: The home cooks are put to the test with a taste challenge before being split into two teams, with the goal of creating a Thali that showcases the very essence of India, incorporating both time-honoured techniques and unique flavours.

videos.title: Honouring The Dabbawalas
videos.overview: The home cooks have the privilege of feeding the special guests for the evening, the Dabbawalas of Mumbai. These dedicated individuals have been serving the people of Mumbai for over a century, delivering home-cooked meals to workers across the city with unparalleled efficiency and dedication.

videos.title: Triple Challenge
videos.overview: In this gruelling triple challenge, home cooks face scrutiny on three distinct parameters: taste, innovation, and presentation. Each aspect will be judged separately, putting their culinary skills and creativity to the test as they strive to impress the expert panel of chefs.

videos.title: Dessert Special Challenge
videos.overview: With celebrity pastry chef Pooja Dhingra as a special guest, the remaining home cooks face their toughest challenge yet - a dessert challenge. As they step up to the plate to impress the chefs with their culinary skills, the intensity in the kitchen is at an all-time high.

videos.title: Double Trouble For The Home Cooks
videos.overview: The competition heats up as the top six home cooks face two unique challenges at the beginning of the finale. With the trophy in sight, they must prove their culinary skills and creativity to the chefs.

videos.title: Biryani Challenge
videos.overview: As the chefs evaluate the home cooks based on the previous challenge they step into the next challenge where they are tasked with mastering the art of making Biryani.

videos.title: Dahi Challenge
videos.overview: The tension builds as the home cooks nervously present their carefully crafted Biryanis to the chefs. However, one unfortunate home cook will be given the dreaded Black Apron. But the competition doesn't stop there, as the remaining cooks are then thrown into a new and thrilling challenge that requires them to showcase their creativity by making a unique drink using Dahi.

videos.title: The Last Mystery Box Challenge
videos.overview: The home cooks are faced with their toughest challenge yet as they prepare for the ultimate Mystery Box challenge. To add to the pressure, they are joined by special guest chef Manish Mehrotra, who is renowned for his culinary expertise.

videos.title: Barter Challenge
videos.overview: In the double elimination challenge, the home cooks face their first task: a barter challenge. They must skillfully trade ingredients with their fellow competitors and utilize them to create a mouth-watering dish. The pressure is on as they strive to impress the chefs and progress in the competition.

videos.title: 100 Steps Challenge
videos.overview: The finalists are pushed to their limits as they tackle a daunting challenge set by special guest chef Saransh Goila. With their culinary skills and creativity put to the test, they must rise to the occasion and impress the chefs.

videos.title: Reimagining The Street Foods Of India
videos.overview: With two home cooks eliminated in the first challenge, the remaining competitors are put into a new cook-along experience. Under the guidance of expert chefs, they must learn and innovate new takes on India's beloved street foods.

videos.title: The Cook-Along Continues
videos.overview: The home cooks endeavour to match the chefs' techniques and pace in the intense cook-along of reimagining the street foods of India. Will they live up to the expectations and progress in the finale?

videos.title: The Ultimate Three-Course Meal
videos.overview: In the finale, the three most outstanding home cooks must gear up for the ultimate challenge, where they are tasked with preparing a three-course meal that reflects their journey on the show and showcases everything they have learned. With the highly esteemed Padma Shri Sanjeev Kapoor as the special guest, the home cooks must give it their absolute best to emerge victorious.

videos.title: The Flavorful Finale
videos.overview: As the curtains draw to a close on this season's MasterChef, the air is thick with tension and anticipation as the home cooks gear up for the ultimate culinary showdown. With the grand title at stake, each home cook puts their heart and soul into crafting their final dishes, driven by their passion for food and their desire to emerge victorious. Amidst the sizzling stoves and the clinking of utensils, who will rise above the rest and etch their name in MasterChef history?

videos.title: Pehli MasterClass
videos.overview: The home cooks embark on an exciting journey filled with fun, games, and the opportunity to learn advanced culinary techniques from expert chefs.

videos.title: Green Kitchen
videos.overview: Home cooks receive a sustainability lesson in the kitchen from the chefs as they learn how to make eco-friendly choices and reduce waste.

videos.title: Senses Ka Khel
videos.overview: The chefs conduct a lesson that emphasizes the importance of sensory perception in cooking. Home cooks learn how to heighten their senses to fully experience the beauty of food and understand how to combine different flavours and ingredients to create delicious and visually stunning dishes.

videos.title: Celebrating The Harvest
videos.overview: The chefs impart a lesson to the home cooks that includes both the preparation of dishes inspired by the harvest season and education on the frequently used language and terminology within the culinary world.

videos.title: Chai Ki Tapri
videos.overview: In an exciting culinary lesson, chef Garima imparts her knowledge on how to make a delectable Chai Tapri-inspired dessert while chef Vikas teaches them how to create a stunning edible cherry blossom tree.

videos.title: Auditions - Part 1
videos.overview: Three of the most celebrated chefs of India, Chef Ranveer Brar, Chef Vikas Khanna and Chef Pooja Dhingra, test home cooks from all across the country and choose the best to get them ready for the MasterChef kitchen.

videos.title: Auditions - Part 2
videos.overview: Three of the most celebrated chefs of India, Chef Ranveer Brar, Chef Vikas Khanna and Chef Pooja Dhingra, test home cooks from all across the country and choose the best to get them ready for the MasterChef kitchen.

videos.title: Auditions - Part 3
videos.overview: Three of the most celebrated chefs of India, Chef Ranveer Brar, Chef Vikas Khanna and Chef Pooja Dhingra, test home cooks from all across the country and choose the best to get them ready for the MasterChef kitchen.

videos.title: Bootcamp - Part 1
videos.overview: The Top 22 contestants face a challenging cook-off, where they compete not just against each other but also against time. By the end of the week, only the Top 12 will get a chance to battle it out in the kitchen for the MasterChef title.

videos.title: Bootcamp - Part 2
videos.overview: The Top 22 contestants face a challenging cook-off, where they compete not just against each other but also against time. By the end of the week, only the Top 12 will get a chance to battle it out in the kitchen for the MasterChef title.

videos.title: Regional Core Ingredient Challenge
videos.overview: The Top 12 home cooks kick off the first challenge by using ingredients from their regions. Mid-challenge, the judges introduce three surprise ingredients to incorporate. Two contestants with the least impressive dishes exit the immunity pin race.

videos.title: Giant Mystery Box Challenge with Chef Kunal Kapur
videos.overview: The home cooks face the world's biggest Mystery Box in a challenge with Chef Kunal Kapur. Inside, they find 10 ingredients and 10 tools. Each cook must craft a dish using at least 4 ingredients and 1 tool within 60 minutes. The competition heats up as 2 contestants are eliminated from the immunity pin race.

videos.title: Overnight Challenge with Chef Suvir Saran - Part 1
videos.overview: Chef Suvir Saran introduces a novel challenge in the MasterChef Kitchen: The Overnight Challenge. Split into 2 parts, cooks have 45 minutes to prep, allowing for fermentation, marination, and slow cooking. They return after 12 hours and have 60 minutes to finish their dishes. In the end, 3 underwhelming dishes lead to elimination from the immunity pin race.

videos.title: Overnight Challenge with Chef Suvir Saran - Part 2
videos.overview: Chef Suvir Saran introduces a novel challenge in the MasterChef Kitchen: The Overnight Challenge. Split into 2 parts, cooks have 45 minutes to prep, allowing for fermentation, marination, and slow cooking. They return after 12 hours and have 60 minutes to finish their dishes. In the end, 3 underwhelming dishes lead to elimination from the immunity pin race.

videos.title: Chef Pooja Dhingra’s Replication Challenge
videos.overview: In the final challenge of the week, five home cooks aim to replicate Chef Pooja Dhingra's Universe of Happiness. They must follow the recipe and create the dish within 150 minutes. The home cook who best captures taste, innovation, and presentation earns the season's first immunity pin.

videos.title: ASMR Challenge
videos.overview: The home cooks usually focus on taste, innovation, and presentation. But this time, they must add a 'sound factor' to their food. After this challenge, two contestants will don black aprons and cook the entire week until they claim the title of the best dish of the day.

videos.title: Vikas Khanna's Innovation Challenge
videos.overview: Innovation is the key to winning this challenge. The 12 home cooks must create a dish using the ingredients from one of the three signature dishes presented. At the 30-minute mark, three dishes are disqualified based on innovation, and at the 60-minute mark, 3 more are disqualified for presentation. Only six dishes will be tasted, with the best securing a spot for the week.

videos.title: Chef Marco Pierre White – Water Mystery Box and Katauti Challenge: Part 1
videos.overview: Chef Marco Pierre White takes over the MasterChef Kitchen with a unique challenge. Home cooks face limited gas, electricity, and a mystery box containing just 250 ml of water. In this 90-minute challenge, the first 15 minutes have no gas or electricity. The following 30 minutes offer only electricity, then 30 minutes of gas, and the last 15 minutes both are available. The best dish wins an advantage for next week, while the top 4 are saved for the week.

videos.title: Chef Marco Pierre White – Water Mystery Box and Katauti Challenge: Part 2
videos.overview: Chef Marco Pierre White takes over the MasterChef Kitchen with a unique challenge. Home cooks face limited gas, electricity, and a mystery box containing just 250 ml of water. In this 90-minute challenge, the first 15 minutes have no gas or electricity. The following 30 minutes offer only electricity, then 30 minutes of gas, and the last 15 minutes both are available. The best dish wins an advantage for next week, while the top 4 are saved for the week.

videos.title: Chef Ranveer Brar’s Pressure Test Challenge
videos.overview: In this week's final challenge, Chef Ranveer Brar sets up the season's first pressure test. Eight home cooks must recreate his dish to avoid elimination. As the challenge ends, the two weakest dishes lead to eliminations.

videos.title: Veeba Blindfold Taste Test + Safe Or Secret Mystery Box Challenge with Prateek Sadhu
videos.overview: Week 4 kicks off with a Veeba Blindfold Taste Test. Home cooks must identify Veeba Sauce ingredients, with the highest correct answers earning 10 extra minutes in the next challenge. Then, Chef Prateek Sadhu presents a Safe Mystery Box with visible ingredients, offering 60 minutes of cooking time, and a Secret Mystery Box with concealed ingredients, allowing 75 minutes for preparation. The top 2 dishes will receive advantages in the following challenge.

videos.title: Team Service Challenge at Mulk Restaurant: Part 1
videos.overview: In the first Local Offsite and Team Service Challenge at Mulk Restaurant, the chefs of the two top dishes become captains, choosing their team members. They craft a 3-course pre-Partition Indian meal with mentoring from Mulk's owner and chef. The teams battle for immunity from the elimination challenge.

videos.title: Team Service Challenge at Mulk Restaurant: Part 2
videos.overview: In the first Local Offsite and Team Service Challenge at Mulk Restaurant, the chefs of the two top dishes become captains, choosing their team members. They craft a 3-course pre-Partition Indian meal with mentoring from Mulk's owner and chef. The teams battle for immunity from the elimination challenge.

videos.title: Liquid to Dessert Challenge with Tejasvi Chandela
videos.overview: Five home cooks enter the kitchen to face Chef Tejasvi's Liquid to Dessert challenge. Assigned one of the five unique drinks, the home cooks must make a MasterChef-worthy dessert, keeping in mind the essence of the drink they were assigned. The best dish earns immunity from the elimination challenge.

videos.title: Chef Vicky Ratnani's Pressure Test
videos.overview: The last challenge of the week - a classic Pressure Test! Chef Vicky Ratnani brings one of his favourite dishes for the home cooks to replicate. The home cook who fails to impress will be eliminated.

videos.title: Diwali Challenge with Family
videos.overview: On the auspicious day of Diwali, the home cooks meet their family members, waiting with a small gift, in the MasterChef kitchen. The home cooks must make a dish celebrating Diwali on a plate using India Gate Basmati Rice. The six best dishes fight for an advantage in the next challenge.

videos.title: Diwali Challenge / Core Ingredient Challenge
videos.overview: The six best Diwali on a plate dishes fight for an advantage - the elusive Veeba Game Changer Card. The advantage grants the winner the ability to skip one of the next week's initial two challenges. Assigned one of the six core ingredients, the home cooks pair up with one of the previous season's Top 6 matching their core ingredients.

videos.title: Core Ingredient Challenge with Last Season's Top 6
videos.overview: Having paired up with the previous season's contestants based on their core ingredients, the home cooks lead as head chefs while the ex-contestants become their sous chefs. The winner receives immunity for the week and secures the coveted Veeba power card.

videos.title: 5 Finger Nutrition Challenge with Pooja Makhija
videos.overview: Nutritionist Pooja Makhija presents a challenge. The eight home cooks aim to create a balanced, nutritious dish, considering the five vital nutrients for a healthy life. Their sole pantry is the Pyramid, its five levels symbolizing each nutrient. Judges unveil a mid-challenge twist: the mandatory use of two revealed ingredients. The top four dishes receive immunity for the week.

videos.title: Chef Garima Cook Along Challenge
videos.overview: Four home cooks face the first Cook Along of the season with Chef Garima Arora. The home cooks must cook alongside her, matching her speed, techniques and detailing to avoid elimination. Only the Top 8 will move on to Week 6.

videos.title: Fire, Water and Earth Mystery Box
videos.overview: The judges of 'MasterChef India - Tamil' bring the first challenge of the week to the eight remaining home cooks. From each of the three Mystery Boxes, the Fire Mystery Box, Water Mystery Box and Earth Mystery Box, the home cooks must use an ingredient and create a MasterChef-level dish in 60 minutes. The bottom dish of the day is directly sent into the elimination challenge.

videos.title: Zero Waste Sustainability Challenge – Maggi Masala Ae Magic Kitchen Kari Challenge
videos.overview: Seven home cooks take on the zero-waste sustainability challenge where the main ingredient is coconut. The contestants must make a dish that maximises the utilisation of the ingredient with the bottom dish sending its maker directly into elimination. The special guests for this episode are the judges of 'Masterchef India - Telugu'.

videos.title: Gourmet Street Food Team Service Challenge: Saffron - Part I
videos.overview: This offsite challenge takes the remaining six home cooks from the MasterChef Kitchen to JW Marriot's Saffron, where they are split into two teams to tackle a team service challenge. They must present a gourmet street food platter in a magnificent way along with a Veeba Mayonnaise Dip. The team that loses goes into the elimination challenge.

videos.title: Gourmet Street Food Team Service Challenge: Saffron - Part II
videos.overview: This offsite challenge takes the remaining six home cooks from the MasterChef Kitchen to JW Marriot's Saffron, where they are split into two teams to tackle a team service challenge. They must present a gourmet street food platter in a magnificent way along with a Veeba Mayonnaise Dip. The team that loses goes into the elimination challenge.

videos.title: Smell Test + Masala Blend Challenge
videos.overview: It's black apron day and the five home cooks face the two challenges set by guest chef Ajay Chopra. The first is a smell test where the home cooks must identify the spices in the different masala blends presented through their sense of smell only. The home cook with the most number of correct guesses gets an advantage for the next round. In the second round, the home cooks must highlight their masala blend in a MasterChef-level dish, with the worst one seeing its creator being eliminated.

videos.title: Grains Mini Challenge + Millets Core Ingredient Challenge
videos.overview: Chef Anahita Dhondy kicks off Week 7 with a two-level challenge. In the first round, the home cooks must guess the different types of grains presented, with the winner getting an advantage for the next round. In the second round, the home cooks use millets as their primary ingredient with a mid-challenge twist. The home cook presenting the worst dish of the day will find themselves in the next elimination.

videos.title: Aashirvaad Select Atta Fan Feast Challenge
videos.overview: Divided into two teams, the home cooks must prepare a feast for their fans and include a bread basket using Aashirvaad Select Atta. The fans and judges vote for their favourite dishes, with the winning team earning a huge advantage for the next challenge.

videos.title: Dream On A Plate Challenge – Maggi Apna Food Business: Part I
videos.overview: Based on the aspirations of the six home cooks, the contestants must create a culinary masterpiece reflecting their dreams on a plate. To help them, Chef Saransh Goila enters the MasterChef kitchen. The best dish receives a special prize, along with becoming the first finalist of the season.

videos.title: Dream On A Plate Challenge – Maggi Apna Food Business: Part II
videos.overview: The judges taste the dishes that reflect the contestants' dreams on a plate. The best dish receives a special prize, along with becoming the first finalist of the season.

videos.title: Time or Ingredient Challenge
videos.overview: Chef Hussain Shahzad brings the last black apron challenge of the season and the home cooks must choose what is more important to them - time or ingredients. The worst dish of the day will be eliminated.

videos.title: Audition Core Ingredient Challenge
videos.overview: For making it to the final week of MasterChef India, the Top 6 home cooks are presented with a Spaces hamper. The week kicks off with a challenge where the home cooks are given an ingredient from the dish they presented in their audition. They must use the ingredient as a core and feature it in their dish. The one that falls short will have their cook eliminated.

videos.title: Chef Manu Chandra Pressure Test
videos.overview: Guest Chef Manu Chandra presents a challenge where the home cooks must replicate his signature dish in 120 minutes. The home cook who falls short will leave the MasterChef kitchen.

videos.title: Chef Manish Mehrotra's Photo Replication Challenge - Part I
videos.overview: The Top 4 home cooks get a surprise visit from Veeba founder Viraj Bahl, who presents them with special Veeba hampers. Guest Chef Manish Mehrotra presents them with a Photo Replication Challenge, where the home cooks' culinary skills are put to the test. They must replicate the dish sketched by Manish Mehrotra within 120 minutes.

videos.title: Chef Manish Mehrotra's Photo Replication Challenge - Part II
videos.overview: The Photo Replication Challenge continues with the contestants bidding for time with Guest Chef Manish Mehrotra. The amount of time they bid is doubled and deducted from the 120 minutes they have for the challenge.

videos.title: Grand Finale - Signature Dish Challenge
videos.overview: In the ultimate challenge of the competition, the last four home cooks will prepare their signature dish in 90 minutes. The judges evaluate these creations based on three crucial criteria - taste, innovation, and presentation. The dish that accumulates the highest score in this challenge will win the title of MasterChef India.

videos.title: MasterClass: Giant Macaron Cake and Giant Chocolate Cookie
videos.overview: Macaron Queen Chef Pooja Dhingra takes us on a baking tour with her two signature dishes. She shares the recipes for her Giant Macaron Cake and Giant Chocolate cookie, dotted with interesting facts about baking and Chef Pooja's journey to becoming the Macaron Queen.

videos.title: MasterClass: Date Night with Chef Vikas Khanna and Chef Pooja Dhingra
videos.overview: Chef Vikas and Chef Pooja curate a perfect dinner date menu that is an expression of love and gratitude. With love in the air and dinner on the table, Chef Vikas and Chef Pooja jointly serve a three-course meal with a salt-baked Kohlrabi appetizer, a main course of Mushroom Ragu with glazed rice and ending it with a sweet affair of chocolate mousse cake.

videos.title: MasterClass: One King Ingredient with Chef Vikas Khanna and Chef Pooja Dhingra
videos.overview: In a showcase of skills, Chefs Vikas and Pooja prepare a dish using just one ingredient each and treating it as the king of the plate. They play with textures and curate a dish out of potato and milk by featuring them. They aim to inspire viewers to get creative and aim for the perfect dish with minimal ingredients.

videos.title: MasterClass: Game Night with Chef Ranveer Brar and Pooja Dhingra
videos.overview: Presenting a beautiful platter of food for friends while hosting game night will be a breeze thanks to Chefs Ranveer and Pooja. Along with a MasterClass on making never-ending cannoli chaat and three different flavours of choux pastries, the chefs also share interesting anecdotes from their own friends and family groups and game nights.

videos.title: MasterClass: Chef Vikas’s Touch
videos.overview: From New York, Chef Vikas brings two recipes - the Khasta Kachori and Kashmir ke Os - and shares his experiences and journey through them. No matter how far he may be from India, he has never forgotten his roots; which is why no matter where he goes, he goes by 'beDesi'.

videos.title: MasterClass: Pastries with Chef Pooja Dhingra
videos.overview: Chef Pooja presents a hack to pack homemade desserts for travel, solves the problem for all those who couldn’t make cakes their travel companion, and tricks everyone with her pumpkin which is in reality a pumpkin mousse pastry. She also gives an interesting insight into making your own moulds.

videos.title: MasterClass: What’s in the Refrigerator with Chef Vikas Khanna
videos.overview: Chef Vikas is excited to curate something out of the leftovers in his refrigerator and elevates an ordinary Mutton Biriyani into Pardanasheen Biriyani. He takes us back to his hometown, Amritsar, and showcases the Roti Chori that tasted exactly like how his grandmother made it.

videos.title: MasterClass: Alternative Cooking with Chef Ranveer Brar and Chef Vikas Khanna
videos.overview: Chef Vikas takes a healthier approach to an Indian thali but this time with millets in an Ethiopian platter. On the other hand, Chef Ranveer Brar finds an alternative cooking technique to satisfy the taste buds but not harm the environment by making Laal Maas Tart out of Banana Flower.

videos.title: MasterClass: Spices of India with Chef Pooja Dhingra and Chef Ranveer Brar
videos.overview: Chefs Pooja Dhingra and Ranveer Brar talk about the spices in India and kick it off with a fun tasting game with the home cooks. Chef Pooja prepares Dal Khichdi and elevates it with spices. She shares an anecdote from when she was living all by herself in Paris and how this particular dish was her lifeline to India. She finishes her course with a Strawberry Not Tiramisu Cake. Meanwhile, Chef Ranveer cooks Prawns Koliwada.

videos.title: MasterClass: Chef Ranveer’s Recipes
videos.overview: Chef Ranveer takes us to his culinary journey from his childhood to his earlier days in the profession. He shares his experiences and how Saro ke Galouti Kebab and Pithode played an important role in building his career.

videos.title: Rishton Ka Swaad
videos.overview: MasterChef India returns with a fresh twist, where pairs step into the kitchen to cook, compete, and celebrate India's vibrant flavours together.

videos.title: Swaad Ke Jaadu Ka Pitara
videos.overview: Paired up and fired up, our next batch of contestants are ready to impress the chefs. Who will make the cut?

videos.title: Rishta Plate Mein
videos.overview: Day three raises the stakes as contestant pairs from across the country bring bold indigenous flavours to the chefs' table.

videos.title: Swaad Aur Rishton Ki Mithaas
videos.overview: The final day of auditions arrives as pairs from across the country get one last chance to secure their aprons from the chefs.

videos.title: Agnee Pariksha
videos.overview: The competition intensifies as boot camp starts and contestants battle for a place in the top twelve.

videos.title: Divine Mystery Box
videos.overview: Creativity meets pressure as the final twelve pairs enter the kitchen for the Divine Mystery Box Challenge.

videos.title: Anna Mahotsav
videos.overview: With Shilpa Shetty Kundra gracing the MasterChef kitchen as the special guest, the spotlight turns to India's ancient supergrains as the contestants take on the challenge of celebrating the power and pride of millets.

videos.title: Celebrating The Harvest Season
videos.overview: Divided into teams and fighting for immunity, the contestants prepare to curate a three-course meal inspired by the colours, flavours, and traditions of the harvest season.

videos.title: Army Day Celebrations
videos.overview: On Army Day, the MasterChef kitchen salutes the armed forces as Retd. Col. Kaushal Kashyap, Retd. Lt Col. Kaushalendra Singh, and Retd. Col. Rajeev Bharwan join the contestants for a heartfelt tribute to our brave soldiers.

videos.title: The Great Indian Mishtan
videos.overview: The race for immunity intensifies as the contestants take on a demanding challenge to reinvent the iconic sweets of India, pushing their skills and imagination to the limit.

videos.title: Shaadi Ki Rasmein
videos.overview: As celebrated caterer Munna Maharaj joins the evening, the contestants express their culinary mastery through dishes inspired by the timeless traditions of Indian weddings.

videos.title: Haldi Aur Mehendi
videos.overview: Joined by Sugandha Mishra and Sanket Bhosale, the contestants embrace a wedding-themed challenge that celebrates Haldi and Mehendi through yellow and green ingredients.

videos.title: Shaadi Ka Shubh Mahurat
videos.overview: Bhavna and Chunky Panday join the contestants for a grand celebration of Shaadi Ka Shubh Mahurat as they take on the season's first high-stakes team service challenge. Who will rise to the occasion?

videos.title: Baraatiyo Ka Swagat
videos.overview: With the Baraati arriving, the contestants put their best foot forward to impress with flavour, service, and celebration. Who will win the team service challenge?

videos.title: First Elimination Challenge By Chef Kunal Kapur
videos.overview: The home cooks face their first elimination challenge of the season as Chef Kunal sets a demanding task. How will they perform under pressure?

videos.title: Har Plate Mein India
videos.overview: With Irina and Agu Stanley as special guests, the contestants celebrate Republic Day through a challenge that brings together ingredients from all parts of India.

videos.title: The Modak Challenge
videos.overview: The elegant and beautiful Karisma Kapoor brings a unique Modak challenge for the contestants, where their innovation and creativity will be put to the test.

videos.title: Reinventing The Kapoor Favourites
videos.overview: With Karisma Kapoor watching closely, the contestants must reinvent the Kapoor family's favourite dishes while balancing flavour, technique, and nostalgia.

videos.title: Restaurant Takeover Challenge
videos.overview: It is a true test of teamwork and pressure as the contestants divide into teams for the season's first restaurant takeover at Mainland China.

videos.title: Pehla Pressure Test
videos.overview: It is a make-or-break moment as the contestants step into their first pressure test of the season, tasked with recreating Chef Kunal's dish down to the finest detail.

videos.title: Organ Mystery Box
videos.overview: With Acharya Manish joining the contestants to celebrate the rich Ayurvedic legacy, they must give their best in the organ mystery box challenge.

videos.title: Kitty Party Challenge
videos.overview: With special guest Ssunita Ahuja in the kitchen, contestants take on an imaginative challenge to craft edible bracelets. Will they meet the expectations?

videos.title: Kitty Party Platter
videos.overview: As the pressure builds, the contestants are tasked with creating a platter that truly demonstrates their culinary range and creativity.

videos.title: One Pot Challenge
videos.overview: With Sanjay Mishra and Neena Gupta in the kitchen, the contestants must excel in the one-pot challenge by showcasing their ability to work within limitations.

videos.title: Cook-Along Elimination Challenge
videos.overview: With chef Sanjyot Keer in the kitchen, the contestants face a high-pressure cook-along elimination challenge, recreating his dish step by step with absolute precision to stay in the competition.

videos.title: No Gas, No Water Challenge
videos.overview: With chef Amninder joining as a special guest, the contestants face a challenge that pushes them to question habits, rethink technique, and redefine how they approach cooking.

videos.title: 7-Course Meal Team Challenge
videos.overview: From a demanding smell test to an unexpected challenge by Chef Suvir Saran, the contestants must hold their nerve as they prepare a seven-course meal under severe time constraints.

videos.title: Seven Courses, One Verdict
videos.overview: As the seven-course challenge reaches its decisive phase, Chef Suvir Saran and the MasterChef judges score the teams dish by dish. Which team will hold their nerve and come out on top?

videos.title: The Lucky Dip Challenge
videos.overview: As Chef Ajay Chopra returns to the MasterChef kitchen, the black apron contestants are thrown into the iconic lucky dip challenge. With no control over what lies ahead, they must rely on skill, instinct, and composure to survive.

videos.title: Blind Wall Elimination Challenge
videos.overview: The blind wall challenge puts the black apron contestants to the test as teamwork and coordination become the key to survival.

videos.title: Childhood On A Plate Challenge
videos.overview: The MasterChef kitchen fills up with motherly love as the mothers of Chef Vikas, Chef Kunal, and Chef Ranveer step in, inspiring a challenge rooted in memories and warmth. Adding to the moment, Viraj Bahl, Founder and Managing Director of VRB Consumer, joins in to inspire and encourage the contestants with some goodies from Veeba.

videos.title: Soch, Surat Aur Swaad
videos.overview: In the presence of Angshu Malik, Managing Director and CEO of AWL Agri Business Limited, the home cooks face four mystery boxes themed around fibre, iron, protein, and calcium, with one box opened every 15 minutes. They must create a dish using one ingredient from each box. Who will stand out in this challenge?

videos.title: Get-Set Chocolate
videos.overview: As the semi finale draws near, Chef Ranveer Brar presents a challenge that requires the home cooks to create a chocolate showpiece. How will they perform in this round?

videos.title: Ghar Ka Khaana Adla Badli Challenge
videos.overview: With the contestants receiving home-cooked food from their loved ones and swapping them with each other, can they recreate the same taste and flavours of true Ghar Ka Khaana?

videos.title: Potato Meets Different Cuisines
videos.overview: In the Black Apron Challenge, the contestants must work with a familiar yet demanding ingredient, the potato, to create a MasterChef-worthy dish and stay in the competition.

videos.title: Fire And Ice Mystery Box Challenge
videos.overview: A surprise Fire and Ice Mystery Box Challenge awaits the contestants as they combine contrasting elements to cook a MasterChef-worthy dish and stay in the competition.

videos.title: The Monsoon ASMR Challenge
videos.overview: The contestants step into the Monsoon ASMR Challenge, where they celebrate the rains by creating a dish designed to stimulate all five senses and test their creativity under pressure.

videos.title: Tribute To Mumbai Challenge
videos.overview: The contestants take on a demanding challenge that invites them to explore the many layers of Mumbai through food, set by award-winning chef Vicky Ratnani.

videos.title: Get Set Mumbai
videos.overview: In a high-stakes team service challenge, the contestants must work together to deliver a service inspired by Mumbai. With guest chefs judging every plate, the pressure is on as they push to secure their place in the competition.

videos.title: Chausar Ka Khel
videos.overview: As the competition hits a crucial stage and one duo faces elimination, Chef Kunal sets a high-pressure challenge that leaves no room for mistakes.

videos.title: Continental Mystery Box Challenge
videos.overview: As MasterChef enters its grand finale week, Chef Guntas Sethi and Chef Ajay Chopra introduce a mystery box challenge where home cooks must use one ingredient from each category to create a MasterChef-level dish. Which five pairs will advance?

videos.title: Audition Dish 2.0 Challenge
videos.overview: As the competition approaches its grand finale, the home cooks face a pivotal challenge where they must reimagine their original audition dish with bold creativity and innovation, placing chutney at the very heart of their creation. Which four pairs will advance to the next round?

videos.title: Holi Special Challenge
videos.overview: With renowned and fearless journalist Saurabh Dwivedi as the special guest, the contestants take on a vibrant Holi Tasting Menu Challenge, turning the festival's seven colours into a feast on the plate.

videos.title: Presidential Menu Replication Challenge
videos.overview: With the finale just one step away, Chefs Kamlesh Singh Negi and Prateek Sadhu curate a challenge where home cooks must recreate a presidential meal without any recipe, while staying true to Himalayan flavours. Which three pairs will secure their place in the finals?

videos.title: The Ultimate Signature Dish Showdown
videos.overview: As the grand finale arrives, Chef Sanjeev Kapoor presents the ultimate challenge where home cooks must prepare two signature dishes that reflect their culinary identity. Which pair will be crowned as the winners of MasterChef?

videos.title: MasterClass: Nalli Nihari By Chef Ranveer
videos.overview: Ranveer Brar takes over the kitchen and gives the home cooks their first masterclass, preparing Lucknow's famous Nalli Nihari.

videos.title: MasterClass: Chicken Tandoori With A Twist By Chef Kunal
videos.overview: Chef Kunal Kapur takes over the kitchen as the home cooks learn to prepare Tandoori Chicken with a unique twist.

videos.title: MasterClass: Kathlambe Ke Lamhe By Anshmeet And Prabhdeep
videos.overview: Brother sister duo Anshmeet Singh and Prabhdeep Singh take over the MasterChef kitchen for a special masterclass as they prepare the dish Katlama Ke Lamhe.

videos.title: MasterClass: Charred Eggplant By Chef Kunal
videos.overview: Chef Kunal Kapur returns to the kitchen for another masterclass, encouraging the home cooks to overcome their inhibitions about eggplant. Using the humble ingredient itself as the star, he teaches them to prepare a delicious charred eggplant dish.

videos.title: MasterClass: Phirni Swiss Roll By Chef Ranveer Brar
videos.overview: Chef Ranveer Brar takes the home cooks on a masterclass journey, teaching them how to prepare the classic dessert Phirni using the most basic ingredients - rice, milk, and sugar.
